mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 41 degrees at Verona Community Park under a waning crescent moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to a low of 37 degrees, and we are expecting a dry night with no rain in the forecast.

The city has announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11. Crews will be milling and patching on streets including North Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street, so please follow the no parking signage. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing development projects for the Liberty Business Park.

We have a full lineup of local happenings, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today and live music at Baileys Run Vineyard today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing on November 12 or visit the Mill in Paoli for trivia night on November 12.

Looking at recent reports, on October 25, police responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue. A 40-year-old man was taken into custody for an O W I, first offence.
You can enjoy the Really Reese's flavor of the day at Culver's, which is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
